title: Egg allergy birthday cake near Lidcombe or Silverwater? No eggs, Harris Park
summary:
Egg allergy in the family and a birthday on the calendar near Lidcombe or Silverwater? Every cake at Harris Park has no eggs. Not some cakes. Every one.

Which is why you can skip the ingredient questions at the counter. Pick a size from 6-inch ($39.99, serves 6-8) to 16-inch, choose from 15 flavours, and bring a photo of the design you want.

Order with 48 hours notice. Pickup from Wigram Street, open 11am to 10pm every day, a short drive from Lidcombe, Silverwater and Newington.
